capabilities: Open any note image in a full-screen zoomable overlay
Zoom with scroll wheel, pinch gesture, or keyboard keys
Pan a zoomed image by dragging
Disable zoom per note via frontmatter
Configure zoom step and min/max zoom levels in settings
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian images are fixed-size inline elements with no built-in way to view them enlarged or zoomed.
summary: Image zoom viewer that opens any image in a note in a full-screen modal with scroll-to-zoom, drag-to-pan, and keyboard controls.
